title: GraveGain3DC: LuckyStarShip420 Campaign
description: Train as a human soldier aboard the LuckyStarShip420, the colony ship headed into the unknown GraveGain universe. Choose any of five unlocked simulator exercises, each with two scripted pushes, custom cover/routes, hostile soldiers, and possible alien animals rendered as cyan wireframe models. Includes Arena FPS, Auto-Battler, and RTS Squad modes.

maker.name: Antigravity Dev
